verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's JavaScript scenarios let a request click and fill form fields before returning HTML (e.g. `wait_for_and_click`, `fill`), which covers form and login walls. Custom cookies and `session_id` support authenticated sessions, while premium proxies and `mode=auto` escalation target hard-to-scrape sites without manual tuning. An official MCP server suggests agents can drive this, but nothing documents CAPTCHA solving or an agent autonomously negotiating a login flow. Missing for 10: explicit CAPTCHA solving/bypass, a documented automated login workflow, agent-driven wall handling via MCP, independent or hands-on corroboration.
